entities.name: Weston Hale
entities.description: A charismatic and athletic Sentinel known for being clumsy yet capable of sudden brilliance in battle using wind and lightning abilities.
entities.quote: WESTON HALE — Canon Personality (Your Exact Version) • Core Nature clumsy super athletic charming in any situation friendly with literally everyone extremely handsome (most handsome male Sentinel)

entities.name: Damian Brown
entities.description: A perceptive, quiet analyzer who uses logic and observation, often acting as a brother-in-arms to Rowan.
entities.quote: DAMIAN BROWN — Canon Personality (Based on Rohan) • Similar to Zayn, but with key differences good IQ (2nd after Zayn) calmer and quieter in analysis less lazy than Zayn

entities.name: Zayn Hayes
entities.description: An extremely calculative, research-heavy strategist who acts as the team's official problem solver.
entities.quote: ZAYN HAYES — Your Canon Personality (No Additions) • Based on Jubayer (your real best friend) physically: dark brown skin, athletic witty, charming, respectful huge knowledge

entities.name: Ethan Thorne
entities.description: The leader of the group, serving as the team's moral compass with wind-based abilities and an ambivert personality.
entities.quote: Ethan = your own personality reflection childlike → witty → fun → teasing → stylish → hair always back • Leadership: → best leader → serious when leading → moral compass is strong
